openUiAnatomy: no published Open UI combobox anatomy adopted here — union of salt-ds core's ComboBox (PillInput trigger + the shared Option/OptionList/OptionGroup parts select.tsx's Dropdown also composes), shadcn's dedicated Combobox primitive (new-york-v4, built on @base-ui/react's Combobox), and M3 filled-autocomplete + outlined-autocomplete (one canonical component with an emphasis/variant axis, the same treatment select's filled/outlined tokens got). shadcn's Command+Popover composed pattern, Salt's lab combo-box/combo-box-deprecated, native-select, list-box and list(-next), and every system's real multiselect/pill/chip surface are each declared out of scope with a structural reason in docs/COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md's scope note. THE POPUP AND THE OPTION ARE MODELLED HERE AS PARTS OF COMBOBOX, reusing select.template.json's own boundary decision — see its scope note's 'what would migrate' list, which applies unchanged here since Salt's combo-box and select share the identical OptionList/Option/OptionGroup components.

behavior.pattern: an editable, filterable single-choice combobox: a real, typeable <input> trigger (NOT a button — the defining structural difference from select), plus a popup listbox of options filtered by the typed text. The cross-system axes are: whether a filter is built into the component or left to the consumer, whether a dedicated disclosure-toggle button exists as a SEPARATE element from the input, whether a dedicated clear button exists, whether a dedicated empty-state message exists, HOW selection is marked (a trailing checkmark vs a filled option background, the same split select found), and whether pointer hover moves the active/highlighted option.
behavior.chassis: skeleton/combobox.tsx — written from the template's part union (root, trigger input, toggle button, clear button, popup surface, listbox, group, group label, option, selected marker, separator, empty state); inherits from no design system. Typing filters the option list with a case-insensitive substring match (the registry's own declared default — see behavior.registry-filter-default), Arrow keys move a highlighted option while REAL DOM FOCUS STAYS ON THE INPUT (virtual focus via aria-activedescendant, confirmed real in all three systems — see behavior.focus-model), Enter commits, Escape closes, an outside click dismisses. The floating-position engine each real system composes is a DECLARED GAP, see behavior.positioning-engine.
